title: Sine space / walk the equation
question: What is it to stand on sin(x) * cos(z)?
reference: A smooth sin * cos ground with trimesh collision; ridges and troughs invite directional walking. (The wavefunctions sine_space is the room version; this is the floor.)
physical_model: Static ground. Height is wave_amplitude * sin(x f + px) * cos(z f + pz) * height_scale.

slot.note: Fitted by TopologySpace.fit_slot: footprint minus the margin, the lowest point on the pool floor, the highest 0.1 m under the rim, the relief fading to the floor across the edge band. Also stands alone with no slot.

parameters.label: Relief
parameters.question: The overall rise; in a slot the pool depth caps it.
